name: Power HF Co., Ltd.
summary: Power HF Co., Ltd. researches and develops, manufactures, and sells diesel engines in China and internationally. The company offers diesel engines, gas engines, generator sets, and machining parts. Its products are used in stationary power, onshore power generation equipment, marine, agricultural machinery, heavy trucks, and construction machinery. The company was founded in 1920 and is based in Weifang, China. Power HF Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Engineus Power Holding Inc.
